<role>

</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is confusion and errors from unannounced interface changes requiring disruptive retraining. I checked the five most similar items: Shortcut stories 4134 (task list improvements) and 4135 (claim information display) are in-progress features about interface functionality, not advance notice of changes; the Notion pages are release notes (Summer, September) and a task overview dashboard—none address prior notification of UI changes or retraining disruption. No completed story or roadmap item covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
